name: Shamhuth
title: Descendant of Judah
summary: Shamhuth was a descendant of Judah through the line of Perez. He is mentioned in the genealogical lists in 1 Chronicles and in the book of Ruth as a link in the lineage that led to King David and thus to Jesus Christ.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in the line of Perez
keyEvents.description: Shamhuth is listed as part of the lineage from Judah through Perez, which is an important line in Israel's history.

keyEvents.title: Part of David's genealogy in the Book of Ruth
keyEvents.description: In the genealogical conclusion of the Book of Ruth, the lineage from Perez to David is mentioned, with Shamhuth (Salma) included as a key link.

keyEvents.title: Ancestor in Jesus' lineage
keyEvents.description: Through the lineage from Judah to David, Shamhuth is part of the messianic line leading to Jesus Christ.

keyEvents.title: Link in Luke's genealogy
keyEvents.description: Shamhuth is also included in Luke's genealogy, which traces Jesus' ancestry back through David and further to Adam.
